title: On the release build the "New" pill ends on the seventh day after release
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use the release build of the release that ships Technician Toggle, and know its scheduled release date.
  • Set your computer's clock to 06:58 UTC on the seventh day after that release date.
  • Start on Settings, Staff.
custom_steps:
1. Open the New Staff Member window.
  2. Set your computer's clock to 07:01 UTC on the same day.
  3. Close the New Staff Member window.
  4. Open the New Staff Member window.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "Technician" label carries the "New" pill.

Step 2:

  • The "New" pill is gone from the open window.

Step 3:

  • The window closes.

Step 4:

  • The "Technician" label shows no "New" pill (if it still shows, the build still carries the 31 Dec 2026 placeholder date).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11879 (Story 1, Technician toggle on a staff member)

  • S1-R2: “A "New" pill sits at the top right of the "Technician" label, touching the end of the word. It looks the same as the pill on the Work Orders display switcher. It shows until 07:00 UTC on the seventh day after the release that ships this feature, then disappears for everyone, including in a window that is already open. The moment is fixed in UTC and read from the viewer's own clock: the pill shows while that clock is before it and is gone from that moment on. The exact date is set when the release is scheduled.”

From: Jira tickets under epic SV-11788 (saved 2 Nov 2026, sources/JIRA-SV-11788-tickets-2026-11-02.md), read 2 Nov 2026

  • Jira SV-12008: “When the release that ships Technician Toggle is scheduled, set the end date of its "New" pills (on the Technician toggle in the New and Edit Staff Member windows, and on the staff list's Technician column header) and of the staff list notice to 07:00 UTC on the seventh day after the release date.”
  • Jira SV-12008: “On the release build before that moment, the pills and the notice show; from that moment on they are gone, including in a page that is already open.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Technician Toggle" (https://claude.ai/artifact/1fuPz8Y4xTg7Syq1mfmJ9R), version 1793629882-06f7, read 2 Nov 2026: page "2 Turn Technician on for a staff member", picture "New Staff Member" (This build)

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • tt-p2-02-after-new-staff-member.png

The design's own words:

  • “The three toggles move to one row of their own below Billable, the same row as Edit: Time Clock, Sales Representative, Technician. Nothing else moves.”
  • “Technician is last, with the "New" pill (same end date as the staff list pill). The window opens with no role and Time Clock off, so Technician starts off and grayed out.”

The design does not draw the window after the end date (register TT-N17).

AUTOMATION: HOLD - the end date is set only when the release is scheduled; run on the release build before release day
